usedFor: Shopify holds your store checkouts, and Dynosend gets the shopper as a contact in an audience through “Create a contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a contact” in Dynosend
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left at checkout joins an email audience, so you can follow up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so the contact appears after the next scheduled check.
